title: Listing Highlight: 100' Azimut Jumbo 2006
description: Discover the 2006 Azimut 100 Jumbo in Miami—a refined Italian-built motoryacht combining timeless design with modern amenities for charter and ownership.
html:
A Sophisticated 100-Foot Motoryacht Designed For Discerning Captains

The 2006 Azimut 100 Jumbo represents a pinnacle of Italian yacht design, blending sophisticated engineering with the spacious comfort that defines the Jumbo platform. Located in Miami and available through FYI Yachts, this 100-foot motoryacht delivers the kind of refined cruising experience sought by experienced captains and charter enthusiasts alike. Built during Azimut’s golden era of design innovation, this vessel showcases the brand’s commitment to quality construction and timeless aesthetics that have made Azimut a leader in the global superyacht market.

The Azimut 100 Jumbo hull design provides exceptional stability and seaworthiness across diverse cruising grounds. The extended beam and carefully proportioned superstructure create generous interior volumes without sacrificing the sleek profile that defines modern Italian yachting. Powered by twin diesel engines, the vessel achieves a comfortable cruising speed while maintaining the fuel efficiency expected from a well-engineered platform of this caliber. The propulsion system has been maintained to exacting standards, ensuring reliable performance for extended voyages or charter operations. Interior accommodations span multiple decks, with a full-beam master suite, generous guest cabins, and crew quarters designed for extended cruising. The main saloon features large windows that flood the space with natural light, while the formal dining area provides an elegant setting for entertaining. A well-appointed galley supports both private and charter operations, and the crew accommodations ensure smooth operations during extended deployments.

The layout maximizes usable space while maintaining the sophisticated ambiance expected aboard a vessel of this stature. The upper deck includes a spacious flybridge with full helm station, lounge seating, and unobstructed views—ideal for both navigation and entertaining. The sun deck provides additional outdoor relaxation space, while the aft deck offers convenient access to water toys and tenders.

Multiple outdoor entertaining areas throughout the vessel facilitate seamless transitions between indoor and outdoor living, a hallmark of thoughtful yacht design. Key Specifications:

• Length: 100 feet | Year: 2006 | Builder: Azimut Yachts

• Twin diesel propulsion with proven reliability and efficiency

• Multiple guest cabins with en-suite facilities and modern amenities

• Full-beam master suite with private head and sitting area Main Characteristics:

• Italian-built quality construction and attention to detail

• Spacious interior volumes with generous headroom throughout

• Multiple outdoor entertaining areas and sun decks

• Proven charter-ready configuration with professional crew accommodations

The 2006 Azimut 100 Jumbo remains a compelling choice for buyers seeking a well-maintained, charter-capable motoryacht with proven performance and timeless design. Whether deployed for private cruising or charter operations, this vessel delivers the reliability, comfort, and sophistication that define the Azimut brand.
